## Pupil sample {#sec-ch3-supp-pupil}

Each trial was epoched from 3 s before squeeze onset at 250 Hz, so sample $k$ falls at $t_k = -3 + 0.004(k - 1)$ s. A trial was retained when it had 3,425 or 3,426 samples and its median time step was within $10^{-6}$ of 0.004 s.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ch3-pupil-flow
#| tbl-cap: "Participants and trials remaining at each step of the task-evoked pupil sample, by task. A window is valid when at least half of its samples are finite. The grip-period model applies its own window check and is not shown."

flow <- read_export("tbl_pupil_flow.csv")
stopifnot(nrow(flow) > 0L)
ge <- if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "$\\geq$" else "\u2265"
stage_lab <- c(
  "v2 trials" = "Behavioral trials",
  "Pupil file present" = "Pupil recording present",
  "Axis accepted" = "Time axis confirmed (250 Hz)",
  "B1 gate" = "Pre-probe window valid",
  "Window gate" = "Task-evoked window valid",
  "At least 20 trials" = paste0("Participant has ", ge, " 20 valid trials")
)
stopifnot(setequal(unique(flow$Stage), names(stage_lab)))
flow$Stage <- unname(stage_lab[flow$Stage])
flow$Participants <- format(flow$Participants, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
flow$Trials <- format(flow$Trials, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
flow$Task <- ifelse(flow$Task == "ADT", "Auditory", ifelse(flow$Task == "VDT", "Visual", flow$Task))
stopifnot(all(flow$Task %in% c("Auditory", "Visual")))
knitr::kable(flow, escape = FALSE)
```

A logistic model (M5) tested whether usable pupil data depended on the condition. Its outcome was whether a trial that could be matched to a pupil recording passed the task-evoked checks, with physical effort, task, a physical effort × task interaction, catch, and centered offset as predictors, and a by-participant intercept. It used the `r v_int("m5_nobs")` trials that could be matched to a recording before the time-axis check (`r v_int("m5_n_participants")` participants), of which `r v_int("m3_nobs")` passed the task-evoked checks. Trials at high physical effort were more likely than trials at low physical effort to have usable pupil data, *b* = `r v("m5_effort_c_est")` (log-odds), SE = `r v("m5_effort_c_se")`, *z* = `r v("m5_effort_c_stat")`, 95% CI `r v("m5_effort_c_ci")`, *p* `r M5_effort$p_fmt` (@tbl-ch3-missing).

```{=latex}
\Needspace{12\baselineskip}
```

## Model estimation {#sec-ch3-supp-models}



All models used the bobyqa optimizer with a maximum of 200,000 function evaluations. A fit was accepted only when it was not singular and the optimizer returned no convergence message. If the maximal model failed that rule, the random-effects structure was reduced in fixed steps: correlated slopes, then uncorrelated slopes, then removal of the random slope with the smallest variance, then a random intercept only (@tbl-ch3-reduction).

```{=latex}
\Needspace{12\baselineskip}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ch3-reduction
#| tbl-cap: "Random-effects steps for each model. A step is accepted when the fit is not singular and the optimizer returns no convergence message."

red <- read_export("tbl_reduction.csv")
stopifnot(nrow(red) > 0L)
step_lab <- c(
  "1_maximal" = "Maximal",
  "2_uncorrelated" = "Uncorrelated slopes",
  "3_drop_b1_state" = "Drop pre-probe slope",
  "3_drop_tepr_state" = "Drop task-evoked slope",
  "specified_intercept" = "Intercept only",
  "same_as_M4b_3_drop_tepr_state" = "As accepted for the task-evoked model",
  "D-S1_drop_x_c" = "Drop offset slope"
)
re_lab <- c(
  "(1 + catch + x_c + effort_c + task_c | subject)" = "Intercept and slopes for catch, offset, physical effort, and task",
  "(1 + effort_c | subject)" = "Intercept and a slope for physical effort",
  "(1 + effort_c + x_c | subject)" = "Intercept and slopes for physical effort and offset",
  "(1 + catch + x_c + b1_state | subject)" = "Intercept and correlated slopes for catch, offset, and pre-probe pupil",
  "(1 + catch + x_c + b1_state || subject)" = "Intercept and uncorrelated slopes for catch, offset, and pre-probe pupil",
  "(1 + catch + x_c || subject)" = "Intercept and uncorrelated slopes for catch and offset",
  "(1 + catch + x_c + tepr_state | subject)" = "Intercept and correlated slopes for catch, offset, and the task-evoked response",
  "(1 + catch + x_c + tepr_state || subject)" = "Intercept and uncorrelated slopes for catch, offset, and the task-evoked response",
  "(1 | subject)" = "Intercept only",
  "(1 + catch || subject)" = "Intercept and an uncorrelated slope for catch"
)
stopifnot(all(red$Step %in% names(step_lab)))
stopifnot(all(red[["Random effects"]] %in% names(re_lab)))
conv <- red$Convergence
conv_lab <- ifelse(
  is.na(conv) | conv %in% c("NULL", ""),
  "None",
  ifelse(
    grepl("isSingular", conv, fixed = TRUE),
    "Boundary",
    ifelse(grepl("failed to converge", conv, fixed = TRUE), "Did not converge", NA_character_)
  )
)
stopifnot(!anyNA(conv_lab))
yn <- function(x) ifelse(as.logical(x), "Yes", "No")
display <- data.frame(
  Model = red$Model,
  Step = unname(step_lab[red$Step]),
  "Random effects" = unname(re_lab[red[["Random effects"]]]),
  Singular = yn(red$Singular),
  Convergence = conv_lab,
  Accepted = yn(red$Accepted),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
display$Model <- id_display(display$Model)
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  display$Convergence <- ifelse(
    display$Convergence == "Did not converge",
    "Did not converge",
    display$Convergence
  )
  knitr::kable(
    display,
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    linesep = "",
    align = c(
      ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{0.48in}",
      ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{0.90in}",
      ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.45in}",
      ">{\\centering\\arraybackslash}p{0.64in}",
      ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{0.86in}",
      ">{\\centering\\arraybackslash}p{0.64in}"
    )
  )
} else {
  knitr::kable(display)
}
```

## Robustness {#sec-ch3-supp-robust}

The primary TEPR summary is the mean rather than the area under the curve, because on these trials the area tracks the mean multiplied by the proportion of valid samples.

R1 replaces the TEPR mean in M4b with the area under the curve, computed over valid samples only. M4b's accepted random-effects structure did not converge for that outcome (maximum absolute gradient `r fmt_sig(as.numeric(v("s1_max_abs_grad")), 2)` against lme4's default tolerance of 0.002). The random-effects structure was then simplified one further step by dropping the offset random slope. That step was accepted (`r v_int("s1_nobs")` trials). The offset × state term was `r v("s1_x_c_teprauc_state_est")` (SE `r v("s1_x_c_teprauc_state_se")`), 95% CI `r v("s1_x_c_teprauc_state_ci")`, *p* `r S1_slope$p_fmt`. The state term was `r v("s1_teprauc_state_est")`, *p* `r S1_state$p_fmt`, and the catch × state term was `r v("s1_catch_teprauc_state_est")`, *p* `r S1_catch$p_fmt`. The area version agrees with M4b in the sense that none of these intervals excludes zero. M4b itself was not changed.


```{=latex}
\Needspace{12\baselineskip}
```

## Additional estimation checks

M1, M4a, and M4b were re-estimated with the optimizers that ship with lme4 (`r v("allfit_optimizers")`). No key-term estimate from a converged optimizer differed from the accepted bobyqa estimate by more than 0.01. The largest absolute key-term deviation in that set was `r v("allfit_max_abs_dev")`.

R2 fits M1's formula to the `r v_int("s2_nobs")` trials from the `r v_int("s2_n_participants")` participants who contributed to the TEPR sample. The maximal model was singular, so it was not accepted. The point estimates were `r v("s2_effort_c_est")` for physical effort (*p* `r S2_effort$p_fmt`), `r v("s2_catch_effort_c_est")` for catch × physical effort (*p* `r S2_catch$p_fmt`), and `r v("s2_x_c_effort_c_est")` for offset × physical effort (*p* `r S2_slope$p_fmt`). They are reported only to show the direction in this subset. They are not a second accepted test.

```{=latex}
\FloatBarrier
\Needspace{12\baselineskip}
```

## Analysis provenance

Recordings are the December 21, 2025, processing of the same sessions. The December 25, 2025, processing added no participant who was absent from the December 21 processing, so it is not in these models.

```{=latex}
\Needspace{14\baselineskip}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ch3-axis
#| tbl-cap: "Checks that the December 21, 2025, recordings are on a 250 Hz axis."

axis_tab <- read_export("tbl_axis.csv")
stopifnot(identical(axis_tab$Test, c("T1 within-trial step", "T2 phase labels", "T3 December 21 vs 25")))
axis_num <- function(note, pattern) {
  hit <- regexec(pattern, note, perl = TRUE)
  parts <- regmatches(note, hit)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) < 2L) stop("axis note is missing an exported number", call. = FALSE)
  as.numeric(parts[2])
}
t1 <- axis_num(axis_tab$Note[1], "= ([0-9.]+)\\s*$")
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(t1, 1)))
t2_dur <- axis_num(axis_tab$Note[2], "duration ([0-9.]+) s")
t2_len <- axis_num(axis_tab$Note[2], "length ([0-9.]+) samples")
t3_b <- axis_num(axis_tab$Note[3], "b = ([0-9.]+)")
t3_r <- axis_num(axis_tab$Note[3], "r at b = 1 = ([0-9.]+)")
r_txt <- sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", t3_r))
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  note3 <- sprintf(
    "Median index scale \\textit{b} = %.3f; median \\textit{r} at \\textit{b} = 1: %s",
    t3_b, r_txt
  )
  n_name <- "\\textit{n}"
} else {
  note3 <- sprintf(
    "Median index scale *b* = %.3f; median *r* at *b* = 1: %s",
    t3_b, r_txt
  )
  n_name <- "*n*"
}
axis_show <- data.frame(
  Test = c(
    "Within-trial time step",
    "Squeeze-gauge duration",
    "Agreement with December 25 processing"
  ),
  n = format(axis_tab$n, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE),
  "Implied step (s)" = {
    step <- as.numeric(axis_tab[["Implied step"]])
    stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(step[1], 0.004)), isTRUE(all.equal(step[2], 0.004)))
    c(formatC(step[1:2], format = "f", digits = 3), "\u2014")
  },
  Note = c(
    "Median step of 0.004 s in every trial",
    sprintf("%g s; median %g samples", t2_dur, t2_len),
    note3
  ),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
names(axis_show)[names(axis_show) == "n"] <- n_name
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  knitr::kable(
    axis_show,
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c(
      ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.85in}",
      ">{\\centering\\arraybackslash}p{0.45in}",
      ">{\\centering\\arraybackslash}p{0.90in}",
      ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{2.11in}"
    )
  )
} else {
  knitr::kable(axis_show)
}
```
